tasks.short: Assess financial exposures and recommend which risks need attention.

steps.what: Read {ERP} exposures, {BANK} balances and treasury-system {OTHER} positions.
Reconcile exposures and calculate concentrations in {SPREADSHEET}.
Assess vulnerabilities using concentration analysis, risk metrics and business plans in {DOCS}.
Write the risk report and proposed mitigations in {DOCS}.

loop.input: Approved analytical findings, calculated tables and report template.
loop.output: Draft risk report with source references.
loop.check: Check every figure against calculated tables; specialist checks conclusions and wording.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass; unresolved claims return to manual writing.

steps.what: Discuss recommendations and agree priorities with the risk owner.
Approve risk actions and record owners in {PROJECT}.

reach.learn: Learn how revenue concentration affects cash and earnings forecasts.

tasks.short: Assess how new legislation changes financial risk and required controls.

steps.what: Read official legislative notices in {GOV_PORTAL} and save relevant versions in {DOCS}.
Read legislation in {DOCS} and extract obligations, scope and commencement provisions.

loop.output: Candidate obligations with article citations, scope and dates.
loop.check: Verify citations and quotations; reviewer checks exceptions, amendments and effective dates.
loop.stop: Process one source pack with one correction pass; conflicting provisions go to legal counsel.

loop.output: Candidate obligation-to-activity links with reasons and source references.
loop.check: Require valid register IDs; specialist accepts or rejects each material applicability link.
loop.stop: One mapping pass per obligation and one revision; ambiguous applicability goes to legal counsel.

steps.what: Resolve applicability and financial consequences with legal counsel.
Prepare an impact brief and proposed control changes in {DOCS}.
Approve control changes and assign implementation work in {PROJECT}.

tasks.design: A scheduled collector versions official {GOV_PORTAL} notices in {DOCS}; bounded extraction and mapping loops propose cited obligations in a {WORKFLOW} register. Reviewed records generate the impact brief, while legal interpretation and approval of control changes stay with people before work enters {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Legal changes combine prose, amendments and jurisdiction-specific scope. Activity and control descriptions are often maintained separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded text extraction can prepare cited records, while deterministic versioning, deadlines and document generation handle the surrounding work.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, transitional provisions and financial consequences can remain uncertain. Legal counsel must resolve material ambiguity.

tasks.altitude: The specialist spends more time discussing implications with control owners and legal counsel. Legal interpretation and control approval rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Track regulatory obligations and control remediation.
reach.learn: Learn obligation ownership, evidence retention and implementation assurance.

reach.task: Assess regulatory effects on financing and hedging.
reach.learn: Learn financing covenants, permitted instruments and treasury operating constraints.

tasks.short: Quantify financial risk with statistical models and validate the results.

steps.what: Extract exposures from {ERP} and market history from market-data software {OTHER}.
Clean, align and reconcile model inputs in {SPREADSHEET}.
Choose model assumptions and scenarios in statistical software {OTHER}.
Run estimates, sensitivities and backtests in statistical software {OTHER}.
Evaluate model limitations and validation results against the model specification in {DOCS}.
Review material changes and approve risk metrics for publication in {BI}.

tasks.design: Integrations build a reconciled risk dataset on the {DATA_PLATFORM}, while configured statistical software {OTHER} runs versioned estimates, scenarios and backtests. Validation exceptions and model reviews pass through {WORKFLOW}, and approved risk metrics feed {BI} and downstream risk assessments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data preparation and run settings were handled separately. Automating calculation did not settle model suitability or validation.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding speeds data adapters and reproducible run configuration. Established statistical libraries and software already perform the numerical work.
tasks.still_hard: Sparse history, changing correlations, tail events and model instability remain difficult. Independent review capacity can limit rollout.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a precise estimate is misleading and choose scenarios that expose the model's blind spots.

tasks.altitude: The specialist spends less time preparing runs and more time challenging assumptions with treasury and model reviewers. Authority to approve material model changes remains unchanged.

reach.task: Validate predictive models and monitor drift.
reach.learn: Learn time-series validation, calibration and reproducible model evaluation.

reach.task: Stress-test the cash forecast.
reach.learn: Learn liquidity horizons, cash-flow dependencies and funding constraints.

evidence.claim: Numerical risk estimates, sensitivities and backtests can run in configured statistical software without a language-model loop.
Automating an approved analytical method is different from validating whether that method remains suitable.

Current statistical software supports saved scripts or repeatable batch runs.
Material method changes receive independent review; routine reruns follow approved validation rules.

Employee consultation is included where national rules require it.

Version assumptions, scenarios and numerical dependencies.
Maintain reproducibility records and market-data entitlements.
tasks.statement: Conduct statistical analyses to quantify risk, using statistical analysis software or econometric models.

tasks.short: Discuss trading strategies and positions with traders to identify and communicate risk.

steps.what: Read treasury-system {OTHER} positions and risk metrics before the discussion.
Prepare sensitivities and discussion points in {SPREADSHEET} and {DOCS}.
Discuss strategy intent, market conditions and risk trade-offs with the trader.
Write the discussion record and circulate proposed actions through {EMAIL}.

loop.input: Specialist's written notes, position snapshot and proposed actions.
loop.output: Draft discussion record with owners, unresolved questions and proposed actions.
loop.check: Specialist checks attribution, figures and agreement status before internal circulation.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unclear agreement remains explicitly unresolved.
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text notes need interpretation without inventing agreement or losing qualifications.

steps.what: Approve escalated risk actions and record the decision in treasury-system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: A deterministic briefing generator combines treasury-system {OTHER} positions, approved {BI} risk metrics and scenario calculations in {DOCS}. tasks.still_hard: Live market uncertainty, conflicting incentives and tacit strategy knowledge remain human work. Position freshness and escalation discipline matter.
tasks.human_edge: Ask the difficult follow-up question, detect hidden assumptions and challenge a strategy while preserving trust.

tasks.altitude: The week contains more prepared discussions about hedge alternatives and fewer briefing chores. Trading, limit and risk-acceptance rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Learn hedge objectives, instrument mechanics and liquidity effects.

Strategy challenge, negotiation and risk acceptance remain matters for accountable people.

tasks.short: Read financial research and assess whether new methods improve existing risk analysis.

Search scholarly databases and regulatory publications through the research service in {OTHER}.
Read selected papers and record methods, assumptions, limitations and validation results.

loop.output: Research findings with page references and quoted support.

Approve and file the method review with proposed testing priorities.

tasks.still_hard: Equations, methodological weaknesses and transfer to the company's exposures still need expert scrutiny. Licensed sources may restrict retrieval or reuse.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when an impressive published result depends on assumptions the company's portfolio cannot meet.

reach.learn: Experimental design, leakage checks and out-of-sample validation.

Check test results, investigate differences and assess whether controls meet the specification.

tasks.short: Assess how new products or processes affect environmental exposure, long-term growth and profitability.

Read technical studies and identify energy, emissions, resource use and environmental constraints.

loop.output: Environmental impact register with units, scope, uncertainty and source references.

loop.stop: At most twelve documents and two passes per document; ambiguous measurements or conflicting scopes become explicit exceptions.

Agree plausible demand, resource-price, regulatory and disruption scenarios with relevant specialists.
Calculate scenario cash flows, profitability and sensitivity to environmental exposure.
Assess uncertainties, trade-offs and conditions that could change the investment recommendation.
Assemble the assessment pack with assumptions, scenario tables and recommendation.
Discuss the assessment and approve, defer or reject the proposed investment.

steps.what: Collect current exposures, cash positions and existing emergency documents.

Write the contingency plan, checklists and contact annex.
Rehearse emergency scenarios and record gaps in the proposed response.
Approve the revised plan and its delegated emergency authorities.
Distribute the approved plan and schedule ownership checks and future exercises.

Set numerical shocks, timing, dependencies, and assumptions about management responses.
Calculate stressed valuations, cash flows, covenant headroom, and sensitivities.
Assess vulnerabilities, model limitations, and feasible responses to the stressed outcomes.
Assemble scenario assumptions, result tables, charts, limitations, and recommendations into a brief.
Challenge the scenarios and endorse conclusions for planning.
